## Spotify Chat 1.9.0

### Better
- **Lyrics for many more songs**: when lrclib.net doesn't have the song (or not the version Spotify plays, like a single vs. the album version), the lyrics now also come from NetEase Cloud Music and Kugou, two big music services that have most western songs too. Their credit lines ("Lyrics by", "作词") are left out. Only the song's name and artist are sent.
- **The right album and cover**: they now come from Spotify itself wherever possible. On Windows from the media controls (always the album and cover Spotify is playing, read while the overlay is on), on macOS and Linux from the Spotify app, and when you're logged in from Spotify's own search, which also gives every featured artist. Only when none of those knows the song are Deezer, iTunes and now NetEase asked.

New in 1.8.0: animated lyrics and `!queue` into a friend's Jam without a login. See the [1.8.0 release](https://github.com/Doelloosleven/Spotify-Chat/releases/tag/v1.8.0).

### Download the jar for your Minecraft version
| Minecraft | File |
|---|---|
| 26.2 | `spotify-chat-1.9.0+26.2.jar` |
| 26.1.2 | `spotify-chat-1.9.0+26.1.2.jar` |
| 26.3 | `spotify-chat-1.9.0+26.3.jar` |

You also need **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API** for the same Minecraft version. Remove your old Spotify Chat jar. The `.sig` files are for auto-update; you don't need to download them.

## Spotify Chat 1.8.0

### New
- **Animated lyrics**: the lyrics on the overlay now look like a real lyrics screen. The line being sung fills up from left to right, with a glow in the album cover's color at the front and the letters hopping as it passes them. The next line waits dimmed below, and on its turn the lines glide up, each one a little after the one above. Instrumental parts (and the intro) get three dots that light up one by one while they breathe, and pop when the singing comes back. Turn lyrics on in `/spotify` > Overlay > Lyrics, or with `/spotify lyrics`.
- **Song requests without a Spotify login, through a Jam**: only the person hosting a Spotify Jam needs the login now. Start a Jam in Spotify, copy its invite link and type `!jam`. Everyone else gets a **[Join Jam]** button, and their `!queue <song>` goes straight into your Jam: your Spotify Chat adds it by itself and answers "Added ... to the Jam". It works from IRC, the Discord and `/gc` `/pc` `/cc` chat. People asking see "goes into <name>'s Jam" instead of a login prompt. It's capped at 12 songs per 10 minutes and lasts 6 hours after `!jam`. `/spotify jam clear` stops it, or turn off "Add requests to my Jam" in `/spotify` > IRC.

## Spotify Chat 1.7.1

### Fixed
- **Login with the wrong key**: Spotify's developer dashboard now has a "Spotify Soloist API Key" button right next to "Create app", and that key (`spak_...`) doesn't work as a Client ID. `/spotify id` now only takes a real Client ID (32 letters and numbers) and says so when it's the Soloist key. `/spotify login` explains it too instead of opening a login that can't work.
- The login setup text follows Spotify's 2026 rules: it needs Spotify Premium, and one app can have up to 5 users, so a friend can use your Client ID once you add them under the app's User Management.

New in 1.7.0: lyrics on the overlay, song requests with `!queue` (Tab fills in the song), `/irc online` and better album covers. See the [1.7.0 release](https://github.com/Doelloosleven/Spotify-Chat/releases/tag/v1.7.0).

releases.notes:
## Spotify Chat 1.7.0

### New
- **Lyrics on the overlay**: the current line of the song's lyrics shows under the song, in time with the music. Turn it on in `/spotify` > Overlay > Lyrics, or with `/spotify lyrics`. It's off by default: lyrics come from [lrclib.net](https://lrclib.net), so the song's name and artist are sent there. Not every song has synced lyrics.
- **Song requests**: type `!queue <song>` in any chat (or on the Discord) and everyone with Spotify Chat gets a **[Queue it]** button; you get one too. It goes through the IRC, never to the server (`/gc`, `/pc` and `/cc !queue` work as well). Nothing is added unless you click it. The mod adds the song to your Spotify queue through Spotify's Web API (needs Premium and the phone / web player Client ID): the first time you click, Spotify's login opens in your browser, and after you click Agree the song is added right away. Without a Client ID, the button opens the search in Spotify. Press **Tab** after `!queue ` to fill in the song that's playing (or one you played before): `!queue HAZ` + Tab becomes `!queue HAZARD DUTY PAY! - JPEGMAFIA`. Turn requests off in `/spotify` > IRC.
- **`/irc online`**: how many people are in IRC right now (just the number).

### Fixed
- **Missing album covers on the overlay**: songs whose cover couldn't be found online now get Spotify's own cover on Windows (from Windows' media controls). The online lookup also matches names more loosely ("JAŸ-Z", accents), tries Apple's iTunes search when Deezer has nothing, and tries again a bit later instead of giving up when the internet or Deezer hiccups.

You also need **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API** for the same Minecraft version. Remove your old Spotify Chat jar. The `.sig` files are for auto-update; you don't need to download them.

## Spotify Chat 1.6.0

### New
- **GIFs in chat**: GIFs and pictures sent in IRC now play right in your Minecraft chat. Send a GIF on the [Spotify Chat Discord](https://discord.gg/3pNGbfkVgJ) (the GIF button, a Tenor or Giphy link, or an uploaded GIF / PNG / JPEG) and everyone in game sees it move. It scrolls and fades with the rest of the chat, and the message itself just says `[GIF]` (click it to open the link).
- GIFs are only downloaded from Discord, Tenor and Giphy, so nobody can use a link to grab your IP.
- On / off and the size (3 to 12 chat lines, 6 by default) are in `/spotify` > IRC.
